bloc.# · Conception de l'interface homme-mach: # · Human-machine interface design — Can the interface be read, without ambiguity, to tell where the system stands and whether it is leaving its bounds — and does the control that triggers a mitigation resist an accidental gesture when the scenario calls for it?
bloc.# · Conception des fonctions de notifica: # · Notification function design — Do your alert thresholds come from the foreseeable hazards, from the risk rating and from the time the person actually has — and does the alert fire on its own as soon as the system reaches a state that calls for someone?
bloc.# · Conditions relatives aux mesures et: # · Conditions for measures and documentation implemented by the deployer — For each measure the deployer has to implement, do the instructions for use name the risk addressed, what must be put in place (technical, procedural, organisational), the measurable performance criteria, the skills required and the recommended verification methods?
bloc.# · Documentation technique — La documen: # · Technical documentation — Does the technical documentation carry the seven items the standard refers to it (see the documentation table, derived from your answers)?
bloc.# · Délai de réaction — Sans délai de ré: # · Reaction time — Without a reaction time, nothing justifies the choice of measure categories: the score cannot exceed # %.
bloc.# · Exigences d'interface (revue rétrosp: # · Interface requirements (retrospective review) — Does your review interface carry, for each output, its time-stamped log, its input data, its confidence scores, the associated alerts and the system version — and does it let the designated person ADD observations of their own?
bloc.# · Exigences des fonctions de notificat: # · Notification function requirements — Are your notifications perceivable and interpretable under real operating conditions, distinguished by urgency, delivered on a tested modality, and is their escalation logic validated as firing early enough to allow effective action?
bloc.# · Exigences générales (surveillance co: # · General requirements (continuous monitoring) — Does the designated person have continuous, real-time access to the system's ongoing operation and to its notifications — and do they know at any moment whether they can still override an output, cut the system off or reset it?
bloc.# · Fonctionnalité de l'interface — L'éc: # · Interface functionality — Does the screen say what the system can and cannot do, and does it report what it does AGAINST the risk scenarios you identified — not against general curves?
bloc.# · Généralités (catégories de mesure) —: # · General (measure categories) — Do the measures you selected belong to the standard's three categories — retrospective review, alert-triggered intervention, continuous monitoring — or are they designed to meet the criteria of those categories?
bloc.# · Généralités (fonctions d'interventio: # · General (intervention functions) — Without an intervention function, human oversight cannot prevent anything: the score cannot exceed # %.
bloc.# · Identification des scénarios de risq: # · Identification of risk scenarios — With no risk scenario identified, no oversight measure is calibrated against anything at all: the score cannot exceed # %.
bloc.# · Impossibilité technique de l'interve: # · Technical impossibility of real-time human intervention — Where a reaction time leaves no material room for human intervention under real conditions, have you recorded this in the risk management file, together with the minimum intervention time you retain?

bloc.Bloc # sur # · Scénarios et délais — Ver: Block # of # · Scenarios and reaction times — Locked
bloc.EN #:# — Système de management de la qua: EN #:# — Quality management system for the European AI Regulation: Article # — designing, verifying and modifying oversight measures, and monitoring how well they work once the system is on the market, belong to that system.
bloc.prEN # — Gestion des risques liés à l'IA: prEN # — AI risk management: Article # — this is where risk scenarios are identified, estimated and evaluated, and where the risk management file on which oversight measures are calibrated lives.
bloc.prEN #-# — Conservation des documents :: prEN #-# — Record keeping: Article # — the logging on which every oversight review rests, including the recording of interventions.
bloc.prEN #-# — Transparence et fourniture d': prEN #-# — Transparency and provision of information to deployers: Article # — the instructions for use, that is, the vehicle through which deployment-dependent obligations pass from the provider to the deployer.

texte.Aucun scénario déclaré. Le délai de réac: No scenario declared. The reaction time is determined scenario by scenario (#): a single figure for a whole system is almost always wrong.
texte.C'est la catégorie qui permet de corrige: This is the category that lets you correct, escalate and document — not prevent. It suits long reaction times.
texte.C'est la seule catégorie qui n'a pas à r: It is the only category that does not have to wake anyone: the person was already watching. Hence the shortest latency attainable — and the dearest, because it occupies someone.
texte.Ce bloc dépend de : Rôle et périmètre. C: This block depends on: Role and scope. Complete that one first.
This document does not stand alone.
texte.Ce projet de norme n’ouvre pas encore de: This draft standard does not yet open a presumption of conformity.
texte.Choisie seule sur un délai de réaction c: Chosen on its own against a short reaction time, it does not hold the scenario: the output has already gone. Clause # exists for that case, and it asks you to RECORD it, not to ignore it.
texte.Choisissez d’abord votre rôle : la norme: Choose your role first: the standard addresses its requirements to the provider, and passes them to the deployer through the instructions for use.
texte.Choisissez votre rôle — fournisseur, dép: Choose your role — provider, deployer, or both — and answer its questionnaire
texte.Dites si le système identifie des person: Say whether the system identifies people remotely through biometrics: nine requirements depend on it
texte.Déclarez au moins un scénario de risque: Declare at least one risk scenario with its reaction time: it is the reaction time that commands the choice of measures
texte.Elle n'occupe personne à plein temps, ma: It occupies nobody full time, but it adds to the latency the time to notice the alert and to pick the context back up.
texte.La présomption de conformité à l'article: A presumption of conformity with Article # will arise only on the day the standard's reference is cited in the Official Journal of the European Union under Regulation (EU) #/#. That is not the case today: the draft is at CEN Enquiry stage.
texte.Le taux de fausses alertes est le vrai s: The false alert rate is the real subject: an alert that cries out too often is no longer perceived, and the real latency grows without anything in the design having changed.
texte.Le vert de ce parcours dit que ce qu'un: The green of this journey says that what a block asks for has been filled in. It does not say you are compliant: nobody pronounces that yet: the draft is not cited in the Official Journal, so holding it opens no presumption of conformity with Article # — on the day the reference is cited, the same work will count as a presumption.
texte.Neuf exigences et l’alinéa #(#) en dépen: Nine requirements and point #(#) depend on it.

texte.Trois catégories, du plus réactif au moi: Three categories, from the most responsive to the least.
texte.Une surveillance continue sans essai d'a: Continuous monitoring without a usability test (#) is a hypothesis: nothing says the person will see what the screen shows, nor how soon.
texte.— La personne désignée a un accès contin: — The designated person has continuous, real-time access to the system's state, its outputs, its alerts and the availability of the intervention functions.
texte.— Le système notifie la personne désigné: — The system notifies the designated person when it enters a state that calls for human attention or intervention; the person perceives, assesses, then intervenes.
texte.— Les sorties sont examinées APRÈS avoir: — Outputs are examined AFTER being produced, on an interface carrying the log of outputs, their inputs, the confidence scores, the associated alerts and the system version.
